newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 850 MW unit seen back April after maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 850 MW unit seen back April after maintenance.

text.p: The 850 megawatt unit 2 at the Keystone generating station near Johnstown, Pa., is scheduled to resume production by mid-April after seasonal maintenance, GPU Generation Inc said Monday.
The company said the outage, which began last Friday, is expected to end by about April 13.
The adjacent unit Keystone 1, also at 850 MW, was running at normal output, GPU Generation said.
The Keystone facility is operated by GPU Generation and jointly owned by member utilities of the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect pool.
GPU Generation is a subsidiary of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
